output.summary: An aquatic flowering herb native from Ireland to central Siberia and from southern Scandinavia to the Mediterranean, it favours reedbeds and pools with fluctuating water levels. Its finely divided lower leaves are threadlike underwater but have flat, oval segments when emerging above water.
output.edibilityNote: Not widely used because of poisoning danger; its fruits are reputed to cause vertigo, drunkenness and narcotic symptoms.
